Hi Olivia / Kumar,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the clarity on latency targets and the priority workloads. As promised, attached is a concise estimate and a walkthrough deck showing the proposed pilot scope (2 models, 3 concurrent endpoints) and the expected throughput at our recommended Dedicated configuration.

Quick highlights:
- Pilot scope: inference for anonymized triage + clinical summarization (batch and streaming patterns)
- Estimated committed capacity: 2x A100-equivalent GPUs (burst to 4x) — see cost schedule on pg.3
- 90th percentile token latency target: ~220ms (with prefix caching and optimized kernels)

Attachments: Blueleaf_Redwood_Estimate_20270616.pdf (application/pdf)

Suggested next steps:
1) Let me know if the pilot scope aligns with your SRE/infra constraints.
2) If it looks good, we can book a 30-min walkthrough of the deck — I can run through the cost model and the fallback policies.
3) If legal needs an SLA addendum, I can loop in our contracts team (attached sample).

Are you available for a short walkthrough next week? I can do Tue/Wed morning PT.

Thanks,
